newsitem.title: CANADA: RTRS-Placer Dome denies Highland's claim.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer Dome denies Highland's claim.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc denied on Friday that its hostile bid for Highlands Gold Ltd contained defects.
"We don't believe there are any defects in our process and we'll defend ourselves if there is a court action," Placer spokesman Hugh Leggatt said in a phone interview.
Earlier today, lawyers for takeover target Highlands said in Sydney that the company would take legal action if Placer did not amend alleged defects in its offer document.
Placer has offered A$0.75 a share for Highlands.
Highlands has said the offer is inadequate.
And lawyers for the Papua New Guinea company said on Friday that Placer Dome should release all information to Highlands relating to Placer's bid.
The two companies currently work together in a joint venture at the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea. The mine is Highland's main asset.
"Highlands is a joint venture partner in the Porgera project and they know as much about Porgera as we do," Leggatt said. "There is no information about Porgera that we have and they do not have."
He said Placer's offer was based on a belief that the Porgera property had promising exploration potential.
"We don't have any developed plans attached to the bid," he said. "Our interest in Porgera is a belief -- not a knowledge, but a belief -- in its exploration potential."
Highlands' law firm said it would start legal proceedings in Papua New Guinea and Australia unless it heard from Placer Dome by 1000 (Papua New Guinea time) on Monday, December 16.
